details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive simulation designed for children aged 7–12 that bridges the gap between oversimplified space facts and complex aerospace engineering software. Built as a game, application, or digital dashboard, the trainer challenges young users to manage a lunar or Martian outpost by balancing critical life-support resources—such as power, oxygen, water, and food—against unpredictable cosmic threats.
